controls.rule: Integer two-by-two determinantal-divisor invariance under elementary shears
controls.limits: Independent integer characterization; not execution of Smith algorithm, termination proof or all-size certification.

controls.rule: Rational chain-step quotient representatives and graph Laplacian quadratic identity
controls.limits: Q chain shapes1x2 and2x1, entries-2..2; simple graphs n<=4 and ternary coordinate vectors; no torsion or native execution.

controls.rule: Admitted empty/sparse dimension arithmetic and finite-input L1 overflow
controls.limits: 64-bit symbolic size model and Python binary64; no large allocations or Rust execution.
